article.title: 'Brother of the More Famous Jack' finds its way to a new generation of readers
article.summary: It is hard not to fall in love with Katherine Browne, the eager to please, mini-skirted narrator in Barbara Trapido's 40-plus-year-old debut novel, reissued this month.
